description:
Test build. v1.3.0 candidate: selftext inline images + Reddit video player links.

rc4: rif cannot play these player links natively (its built-in player resolves video metadata from media_metadata, which standard single-video posts lack). So tapping a video player link now resolves the post permalink on-device and opens the POST, where rif plays the video inline as with any post link. Brief network delay on tap.
